backbone_composition.description: Composition of the shared backbone (concepts matched by the calibrated annotator in >= 8 of 10 models, mid layer). Class by gene content: the genes that drove each match (top genes falling in the concept, pooled over the features that match it, counting repeats); protein_synthesis if >= 50 % of them are protein-synthesis genes (ribosomal proteins, translation factors, ribosome biogenesis, nonsense-mediated decay; 317 genes), other_housekeeping if >= 50 % are protein-synthesis or other housekeeping families, specific otherwise. Programmes: complete-linkage clustering of the concepts by weighted Jaccard of their matched genes, joined at >= 0.3.
backbone_composition.source: backbone-composition analysis of the paper (step s2_mid_composition), run on the catalogues of release runs-v2
